local_facts.claim: Arvada says its water is soft to moderately hard, ranging from about 20 mg/L to 100 mg/L, with an average of 84 mg/L (about five grains per gallon).
local_facts.why_it_matters: The city says moderate hardness can build scale on pipes. Mineral residue around aerators and valves can be a useful inspection clue, but it is not an emergency diagnosis; a technician still has to locate the actual leak, restriction, or failed part.
local_facts.title: Arvada water is soft to moderately hard

local_facts.claim: Arvada's Stocke Addition was formally platted in 1904 and the Walter subdivision in 1920, while Candelas home sales opened in 2012.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A technician should not assume the same shutoff locations, cleanout access, remodel history, or under-slab layout across the city. Historic areas may have multiple generations of plumbing, while newer western communities have different utility and slab configurations.
local_facts.title: Arvada houses span a century of plumbing layouts

local_facts.claim: A 2022 soils and foundation summary filed in Arvada's permit system for an Arvada Point townhome project identified expansive soil and bedrock, and recommends pressure-testing under-slab plumbing, using flexible couplings, and isolating plumbing that passes through slabs.
local_facts.why_it_matters: That is a site-specific reminder not to treat a recurring below-slab or buried-line issue as merely a surface leak. On an affected property, movement and the line route matter to the repair plan as much as the visible symptom.
local_facts.title: Some Arvada sites require plumbing allowances for soil movement

pricing.table_head: What the common emergency plumbing jobs run in Arvada

anchors.label: Building permit, water heater replacement
anchors.detail: The flat amount Arvada lists for a water heater permit. It is pulled before the old tank leaves the house, and it buys an inspection rather than a piece of paper.
anchors.source_name: City of Arvada building permit fee schedule

anchors.label: Right-of-way permit, one sewer service
anchors.detail: Charged per sewer service when the work crosses the public right of way, which is the same figure as the minimum right-of-way permit fee in Arvada.
anchors.source_name: City of Arvada rights of way fee schedule

anchors.label: Pavement degradation fee, per foot of trench
anchors.detail: Added for every linear foot of trench opened in a city street, plus twenty feet of required resurfacing, which is why a dig under pavement is priced apart from a dig in a lawn.
anchors.source_name: City of Arvada rights of way fee schedule
